text:
Priya Rao: :loudspeaker: Heads-up: starting next week we’re enforcing automatic KMS key rotation for all Private/VPC/on-prem deployments. This affects customers using customer-managed keys (CMKs) or our integrated KMS bridge. Details + timeline below.

Marc Chen: Is this a hard cutoff or a phased rollout? We need to coordinate maintenance windows with Dedicated as well.

Priya Rao: Phased. Rollout plan: week 1 (opt-in preview for new clusters), week 2 (recommended for rolling upgrades), week 4 (enforced for new installs), week 8 (enforced for existing enrollments). We’ll publish a canary cohort list.

Asha Patel: From a compliance POV this is good. Rotation interval is 90 days by default, with 30/7 grace thresholds. We’ll keep audit events for key use and rotations for 7 years in the audit store for customers electing retention.

Jordan Lee: How should CS communicate this to customers? Any customer-impacting steps they need to do? Will there be downtime?

Priya Rao: Minimal impact expected. Most customers with CMKs need to ensure their KMS IAM roles allow rewrap/rotate actions. For our KMS bridge, we will perform rewrap in-place. Brief customer checklist in the doc. No planned downtime, but plan for a short 30s token refresh window during rewrap for in-flight connections.

Clara Nguyen: Added runbook items for on-prem installers: preflight command to validate rotation readiness: 

```
redwoodctl onprem check-kms --cluster CLUSTER_ID
# expects: key_status: ready, kms_policy: allows_rewrap
```

Also included rollback steps if customer key rejects rewrap.

Marc Chen: Ops notes — we will throttle rotation ops to keep p95 latency impact < 10ms. Canary cluster list will be in the shared sheet. @DevOps Bot please schedule a staggered job windows for the canary cohorts.

DevOps Bot: Scheduled rotation jobs: canary-1: 2026-05-04T02:00Z, canary-2: 2026-05-05T03:00Z, batch-1 start: 2026-05-11T02:00Z. Job details: https://internal.redwood/ops/kms-rotation-jobs

Asha Patel: Make sure to include guidance for customers subject to FedRAMP/FIPS: rotation cadence and HSM-backed keys behave slightly differently. Clara can we add a separate appendix for HSM customers?

Clara Nguyen: Yes — appendix added. Key points: HSM-backed keys may require manual rotation steps for air-gapped on-prem; we’ll surface those as customer action items and offer SRE-assisted rotations for enterprise contracts.

Jordan Lee: Action item for CS: prepare customer-facing email template and a short FAQ. I can draft, need Asha signoff for compliance wording.

Asha Patel: I’ll review the FAQ tonight. Focus on: "what to expect", "how to tell if you’re impacted", and "contact for assisted rotation".

Priya Rao: Docs (internal + customer): https://docs.internal.redwood/private/kms-rotation-2026

Priya Rao: TL;DR Action list:
- Engineering: finalize throttling & telemetry hooks (Marc)
- Onprem PM: publish installer preflight + appendix (Clara)
- Security: FAQ + compliance wording (Asha)
- CS: email template + outreach plan (Jordan)
- Ops: schedule canary & batch jobs (DevOps Bot / Marc)

Marc Chen: We should also add a monitoring dashboard tile for rotation success rate and rewrap error codes. I’ll create it and link to incident playbook.

Clara Nguyen: ETA for onprem doc updates: EOD Tuesday. I’ll post the link here when done.

Jordan Lee: Will start drafting customer emails tomorrow and add opt-out instructions for customers who need time (opt-out window until enforcement date).

Priya Rao: Enforcement date (hard): 2026-07-01. Opt-out requests must go through Sales/CS approval and will be rare. We’ll include a migration support SKUs section.

Asha Patel: Marking this as approved for rollout from security side. Will coordinate with legal for any contract language changes.

Priya Rao: Thanks all. Please report issues in #incidents if any customer-facing failures occur during canary. I’ll post a summary after week 1 canary runs. :rocket:

Marc Chen: :eyes: watching the canary metrics. Will report back with any perf regressions.

DevOps Bot: Canary run complete: canary-1 success (0 errors), canary-2 partial (1 rewrap error - auth policy). Incident created: 1819050001. Link: https://internal.redwood/incidents/1819050001

Clara Nguyen: Noted — will follow up on the auth policy mismatch with the customer owner.

Jordan Lee: Draft email is ready for review: https://docs.internal.redwood/cs-templates/kms-rotation-email

Priya Rao: Great. Closing the announcement thread — reopening if we need further exec comms. "
